name: prompt-vault-mod
description: Prompt Vault mod: browse, search and execute saved prompts from inside Claude Code.

submitAsUser.title: Submit as you
submitAsUser.description: Execute submits the prompt as your own words (on) instead of framed as "The Prompt Vault plugin sent a message" (off).

confirmNonClaudeCodeCategories.title: Confirm non-Claude-Code prompts
confirmNonClaudeCodeCategories.description: Ask before Execute sends a ChatGPT, Research, Coding Projects or Other prompt to Claude Code.

pageSize.title: Prompts per page
pageSize.description: How many prompts the menu shows at once.

vaultDir.title: Vault folder (testing override)
vaultDir.description: Absolute path of a folder holding prompts.md. Leave empty to use ~/.claude/prompt-vault.
